title: Scanner success lines next to a test failure
description: The log contains 'no leaks found' and 'No known vulnerabilities found' before a failing test
rationale: Guard for BENCH-CLASS-010: a scanner reporting a clean result must not turn an ordinary test failure into a security finding.
